title: Check Input Resolution
text: Check that input signal has specified resolution, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Resolution} sets Resolution value to compare to input signal scalar; {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the whether to stop simulation when check and {Output assertion signal} sets the create output signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal checked against resolution scalar | vector

params.name: Resolution
params.values: Resolution value to compare to input signal scalar | vector

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: Enable or disable check on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails (optional)
params.values: Expression to evaluate when assertion fails "" (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: Whether to stop simulation when check fails on (default) | off
